summary: The candidate slide successfully replaces the blank template with real content and hits most of the brief's requirements: the locked header and subheader are present, the $1.25M hero ask is prominent in the left block, the three Build/Deploy/Validate milestone cards appear on the right with correct copy, the support stats (2 key hires, 3 pilot sites, 18–20 months runway) are shown, and a bottom ribbon reads 'USE OF FUNDS Build • Deploy • Validate'. However, several issues prevent a full 'applied' rating: (1) the Designer Health footer logo renders as a plain wordmark 'designer' in a different typeface/weight rather than the locked Designer Health logomark seen in the shell and reference slides; (2) the slide is rendered inside a grey browser/viewport surround rather than as a clean white slide filling the frame, breaking the shell contract; (3) the header adds a trailing period not present in the locked spec; (4) the left hero block is visually sparse and the stat row sits above the milestone area rather than integrated into the left panel, slightly misaligning with the 'left hero ask block' layout intent; (5) the milestone cards are condensed to single-line summaries rather than the two-bullet structure specified in the brief.
